requirement.description: The with_name method has incorrect handling of relative paths starting with slash. When a URL like "/a" has its name replaced with "b", it produces raw_parts of ('/', '', 'b') instead of ('/', 'b'). This happens because the method incorrectly treats the initial slash as a separate path component.
requirement.contract: When calling with_name() on a relative URL like URL("/a"), the resulting URL should have raw_parts equal to ("/", "b") where "b" replaces the name part "a". The method should properly handle the root path component and not create an extra empty string component.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method has incorrect handling of relative paths starting with slash. When a URL like "/a" has its suffix replaced with ".b", it produces raw_parts of ('/', '', 'a.b') instead of ('/', 'a.b'). Similar to with_name, the method incorrectly treats the initial slash as a separate path component.
requirement.contract: When calling with_suffix() on a relative URL like URL("/a"), the resulting URL should have raw_parts equal to ("/", "a.b") where "a.b" replaces the name part "a". The method should properly handle the root path component and not create an extra empty string component.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method has incorrect handling of relative paths starting with slash (second case). When a URL like "/a/b" has its suffix replaced with ".c", it produces raw_parts of ('/', '', 'a', 'b.c') instead of ('/', 'a', 'b.c'). The same root cause affects this case.
requirement.contract: When calling with_suffix() on a relative URL like URL("/a/b"), the resulting URL should have raw_parts equal to ("/", "a", "b.c") where "b.c" replaces the name part "b". The method should properly handle the root path component and not create an extra empty string component.

requirement.description: The with_name method has incorrect handling of relative paths starting with slash (second case). When a URL like "/a/b" has its name replaced with "c", it produces raw_parts of ('/', '', 'a', 'c') instead of ('/', 'a', 'c'). The same root cause affects this case.
requirement.contract: When calling with_name() on a relative URL like URL("/a/b"), the resulting URL should have raw_parts equal to ("/", "a", "c") where "c" replaces the name part "b". The method should properly handle the root path component and not create an extra empty string component.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method has incorrect handling of relative paths with empty name. When a URL like "/a" has its suffix replaced with ".b", it should properly construct the path without creating incorrect extra components.
requirement.contract: When calling with_suffix() on a relative URL like URL("/a") with a suffix replacement, the resulting URL should have a properly constructed path that doesn't introduce extra empty string components in raw_parts.
